tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar and unselected chips, on `ground`.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Input fields, tracks of bars and meters, disabled buttons.

tokens.name: photo
tokens.usage: The tile behind a garment cut-out, on `ground` or `surface`. Stays light in the dark theme so black clothes remain visible. No text sits on it.

tokens.name: photo-on-tint
tokens.usage: The tile behind a cut-out inside an OutfitCard, on a `tint-*`. Stays light in the dark theme.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside a card. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls on `surface` or `ground` (secondary button, text field). 3:1 on both.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and the primary action. Reads on `ground`, `surface`, `sunken`, every `tint-*` and every `*-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive icons. Reads on `ground`, `surface`, `sunken` and every `tint-*`.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill (primary button, selected chip, active tab).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, focus ring, job progress and the mark on a tag she edited. Never a button fill for the main action. Text on `ground`, `surface`, `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a tag she edited herself, and of an info banner.

tokens.name: tint-sage
tokens.usage: Card ground of the safe outfit. `ink` and `ink-soft` text.

tokens.name: tint-butter
tokens.usage: Card ground of the bolder outfit. `ink` and `ink-soft` text.

tokens.name: tint-lilac
tokens.usage: Card ground of the experimental outfit. `ink` and `ink-soft` text.

tokens.name: tint-peach
tokens.usage: Ground of the style-profile and gap cards on Wardrobe.

tokens.name: tint-sky
tokens.usage: Ground of empty states and the icon disc on a state card.

tokens.name: buy
tokens.usage: The verdict buy and every reason in its favour: text and icons on `surface`, `ground`, `buy-soft`. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: buy-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the buy verdict pill.

tokens.name: unsure
tokens.usage: Low confidence and an unsure tag: text, icons and dashed border on `surface`, `ground`, `unsure-soft`. Always with a word.

tokens.name: unsure-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an unsure tag chip and a low-confidence banner.

tokens.name: leave
tokens.usage: The verdict leave, every reason against, and delete: text and icons on `surface`, `ground`, `leave-soft`. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: leave-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the leave verdict pill.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The verdict score, once per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one headline of a screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and sheet titles, the verdict word.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under a name. Never smaller than this.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, between a title and its caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the headline, above the primary action.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails and small tiles inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Photo tiles, text fields, item cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, banners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, icon buttons, the tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar and a bottom sheet. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target: icon buttons and tab items.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Height of primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Height of filter and tag chips.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Height of the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: size-screen
tokens.usage: Width of the phone frame every screen is designed at.
